one_line: Kakatiya-era commander and ministerial patron who commissioned the Rudreshvara temple at Palampet.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, tall and athletic with a disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed moustache, faint trimmed beard along the jawline, calm but alert eyes, default expression a composed, thoughtful warrior’s gaze
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted slightly off-center, pulled back into a low, tight knot at the nape and wrapped with a narrow deep-maroon cloth band; small, simple gold stud earrings on both ears
appearance.costume: a finely draped Kakatiya-style warrior-minister outfit: ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti with a deep maroon border wrapped firmly and knotted at the front, a fitted short-sleeved pale-cream angiya-style upper garment reaching just below the waist, and over it a rich deep-maroon silk angavastra with muted gold woven edge, draped from left shoulder across chest and around the back; a broad dull-gold metal waist-belt engraved with simple geometric motifs securing the dhoti, medium-width dull-gold armlets on upper arms, a single modest dull-gold chain necklace, and simple leather sandals; no armor plates, but the fabric sits close to the body, suggesting readiness for movement
appearance.signature: a Kakatiya-style straight sword with a slightly broadened leaf-shaped iron blade, a plain iron crossguard, and a wooden grip wrapped with dark-brown leather, carried in a simple brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back by a deep-maroon strap

ref_desc: Recherla Rudra is a mid-30s, medium-brown, oval-faced warrior with a tight back-knot and maroon headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream angiya, maroon angavastra, dull-gold ornaments, leather sandals, and carrying a leaf-shaped sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Recherla Rudra: a mid-30s Kakatiya commander-minister from the Deccan with a medium-brown oval face, sharp nose, neat moustache and faint jawline beard, calm but alert eyes, and thick black hair pulled into a tight low knot wrapped with a deep-maroon cloth band and small gold stud earrings. He wears an ankle-length off-white dhoti with a deep maroon border, a fitted pale-cream short-sleeved angiya, and a rich deep-maroon silk angavastra with a muted gold edge draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back. A broad dull-gold engraved waist-belt secures the dhoti, with matching dull-gold armlets on his upper arms and a single modest gold chain necklace; he stands in simple leather sandals. His signature weapon is a straight, slightly leaf-shaped iron sword with a plain iron crossguard and dark-brown leather-wrapped wooden grip, resting in a simple brown leather scabbard slung diagonally across his back on a deep-maroon strap. Show him in neutral, front, and side views with clear visibility of face, hairstyle, garments, ornaments, sandals, and sword, keeping the palette to deep maroon, off-white, pale cream, dull gold, and dark brown.
